commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Cesar Soto Grado has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Real Sociedad force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+3' Corner kick. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is ready to send the ball into the box.
90+2' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Decent spell from Ath Bilbao here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The linesman points to the corner flag, Ath Bilbao are going to take it.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
87' The game is interrupted now, Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
84' 60:40 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
82' Imanol Alguacil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) replacing Takefusa Kubo.
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Unai Gomez.
80' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
78' Real Sociedad have been awarded a free kick.
78' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.

78' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Cesar Soto Grado blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick.
76' It seemed like Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
76' One of the Real Sociedad players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
74' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Benat Prados Diaz and he is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
74' The referee signals a substitution. Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Hamari Traore.
72' Rough tackle by Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
69' It seemed like Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
68' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) trips an opposition player and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul. That's a free kick to Ath Bilbao.
68' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
65' Ath Bilbao have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.

62' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Cesar Soto Grado signals. Ath Bilbao win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
62' Substitution. Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta walks off.
62' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta is replaced by Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) replaces Brais Mendez.
62' Sergio Gomez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Inaki Williams will be replaced by Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao).
61' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
61' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
60' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Real Sociedad force their opponents to concede a corner.
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
56' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Real Sociedad out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
56' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.
55' The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.

55' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.
53' Cesar Soto Grado blows the whistle, Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Real Sociedad have a free kick.
52' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
51' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

50' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
50' Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

49' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
49' Real Sociedad will take a corner kick.

49' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the roof of the net. Unai Simon guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Sociedad will take a corner.
46' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
44' Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
44' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

44' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. It's a free kick to Real Sociedad, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
42' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
42' The linesman makes the right call and Real Sociedad will have a corner.
42' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players. Real Sociedad win a corner.
41' Real Sociedad will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
40' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and signals a foul after Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) brought his opponent down. Real Sociedad have a free kick.

39' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
37' Some great controlled play and passing from Real Sociedad. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
32' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Cesar Soto Grado stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
28' Wow, what an escape. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
23' Real Sociedad are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

20' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
19' The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
17' Referee Cesar Soto Grado sees the trip by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
15' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort by making an easy save.
10' The referee awards a corner and Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) goes over to take it.

10' A lofted cross from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
9' Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
9' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) makes a strong challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul. Ath Bilbao earn a free kick.
5' Real Sociedad keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
5' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is able to continue to play.
4' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
2' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Ath Bilbao will take the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will referee today's match.
